title: S&P downgrades Flowers Foods to ‘BB’ on earnings pressure and covenant risks
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings lowered its issuer credit rating on Flowers Foods Inc (NYSE:FLO) to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ on Nov. 23, 2026, assigning a negative outlook as persistent demand headwinds and elevated input costs weigh on profitability. The agency also downgraded the packaged bakery company's senior unsecured notes to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ with a ‘3’ recovery rating, signaling an expected recovery of 50% to 70% in a default scenario.

title: S&P moves Uzbekistan to one notch below investment grade
summary: IntelliNews summary: • S&P judges that Uzbekistan's policymaking keeps improving, with energy and state-company reforms that should help the budget. • Net government debt is modest by global standards and consists mostly of long, cheap official loans for investment projects.
